commit.message: feat(history): record Magi memory actions locally (MAGI-016)

specification.objective: MAGI-016: expose a bounded, profile-local, privacy-safe history of actions initiated by Magi, with filters and confirmed clearing.

requirements.statement: Record Magi-initiated operations with operation, target, UTC timestamp, random correlation identifier, outcome, and redacted error; never store raw memory content, prompts, tokens, or secrets.
Persist history beneath the active Hermes profile's plugin-data/magi directory, enforce bounded retention and file permissions, and offer explicit confirmed clearing.
Expose history query filters for date, operation, and result; distinguish audit history from undo and from external Hermes changes.
Audit logging failure must be surfaced as an auditability limitation without falsely claiming that the operation itself failed or that it was recorded.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A successful Magi write creates a local record containing metadata only, with no raw entry content.
Date, operation, and outcome filters work; retention remains bounded; clear requires confirmation.
A history write failure is visibly reported separately from the native operation result; external Hermes changes are not attributed to Magi.

invariants.statement: History never contains memory entry text, imported/exported content, AI prompts, tokens, credentials, or raw exception messages.

forbidden_states.statement: History presented as undo, complete record of all Hermes changes, or proof that all actions are auditable.

inputs.statement: Only structured outcomes from mutating Magi backend operations; read-only queries and external changes are not recorded as Magi actions.

outputs.statement: Filtered bounded history entries, clear result, and explicit audit-recorded/audit-warning status.

failure_semantics.statement: History persistence failures do not convert a completed native operation into a claimed failure; the response and UI disclose that audit logging did not succeed.
